news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.30 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (down from ₹0.30 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.73m (down 34% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹273.0k (down 83% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.1% (down from 16% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 40% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 2% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
